text.title: EU AI Act Compliance — Examples
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing `eu-ai-act-compliance` applied to a real-shape scenario.

section.title: Worked example: HR-screening SaaS
section.p: System: SaaS tool that scores incoming CVs for fit-to-role across EU enterprise customers. Built on a fine-tuned 7B model + RAG over job descriptions.

list.item: Step 1: deployment_region.contains('EU')=true; primary_purpose='employment screening'; is_gpai=false (downstream fine-tune below 10^25 FLOPs).
Step 2: Article 5 not matched. Annex III(4) employment matched. risk_tier=high-risk.
Step 5: gaps={Article 13: instructions-for-use missing}. next_actions=[draft Article 11 doc, wire override button, publish bias-assessment].
Step 6: legal counsel sign-off pending on borderline Article 9(3) substantial-modification clause.

section.title: Worked example: high-risk credit-scoring agent
section.p: A fintech deploys an LLM-powered credit-scoring agent in DE, FR and NL. It ingests applicant text, retrieves bureau data, and returns an approve/reject decision with a score; the applicant is told the decision is automated.

list.item: Step 2: Article 5 not matched; Annex III point 5(b) — creditworthiness of natural persons — matched. risk_tier=high-risk.

Step 5: bias report over the eval set gives accuracy 0.87 overall, gender gap 0.02, age gap 0.05; Article 13 disclosure copy drafted — "This decision was produced by an automated system. You may request human review under Article 22 GDPR."

Step 7: the reviewer subagent flagged a draft citing "Article 47 high-risk obligations" — no such article exists in this Act. The flag returned to step 5, which corrected it to Article 11 (technical documentation) plus Article 13 (transparency). reviewer_signoff recorded against legal-lead-de.
Step 8: registered as EU-AI-2026-07-DE-0014; post-market monitoring reports monthly bias deltas; the model v2.0 upgrade auto-triggers re-classification through the CI gate.
